integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled finite checker is corroborative only. Broader GU representation formulas and the multiple Chernoff theorem are explicitly credited; no claim of independent audit is made.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite-copy formula is for the regular rebit polygon only. It does not prove the conjectured finite-copy global optimality over all rebit ensembles. The asymptotic uniqueness statement is for fixed ensembles. Unequal priors, mixed states, local-measurement restrictions, and complex-qubit ensembles are outside scope.
title: Exact multi-copy discrimination law for regular rebit polygons
